framework: vanilla HTML + ES modules (index.html, app.js, src/*.js); no build step
font_stack: system-ui stack (tokens.css --font-display/--font-body) + ui-monospace (--font-mono); no web fonts, offline constraint
palette: OKLCH token system in tokens.css — custom dual light/dark theme 'Sakura', muted rose accent (hue 352); medal gold/silver/bronze retained
motion: CSS transitions/animations only (no framer-motion / gsap / motion / lenis); every motion has a prefers-reduced-motion fallback
preserve: routes, element IDs, and component ownership
introduce: dual light/dark theme with persisted toggle (no-FOUC)
design.md as the system of record
notes: tokens.css and design.md now exist; .hallmark/log.json has entries. Test suite is 75 tests (`node --test`). Theme follows prefers-color-scheme by default and persists the user's choice to localStorage key `oped-theme`.
